provenance: Country-level indicators compiled at build time. Grid carbon intensity and low-carbon share: Our World in Data 'Energy' dataset (CC-BY 4.0), compiling Ember and IEA statistics. Baseline water stress: WRI Aqueduct 4.0 via the World Bank Data360 API, industrial-weighted where published. These are NATIONAL aggregates and are not site-level measurements -- water stress in particular varies substantially within large countries.

waterStress.name: WRI Aqueduct 4.0 (via World Bank Data360)
waterStress.note: Aqueduct's baseline represents 1979-2019 conditions, not a single year.
